digest.component_or_area: LLM runner except spine / failure interpretation seam
propositions: Extract the except spine of run() into interpret_failure() in structured_run.py while leaving the finally teardown block in run().

The except-arm order (UsageLimitExceeded, then LLMError, then broad Exception, with sampling-rejection translation first) must be preserved because broad-first ordering silently reclassifies typed failures as provider outages.
Arm-ordering tests must assert type(x) is rather than isinstance, since LLMConfigError subclasses LLMUnavailableError and would pass an isinstance check vacuously.
translate_sampling_parameter_rejection only inspects and reclassifies; it performs no retry and does not alter the resolve-then-execute shape.
No monkeypatch targets lie in the except spine, so this extraction requires zero repoints (measured, not assumed).

The CURRENT(file:line) markers in test_llm_failure_matrix.py must be retargeted to real numeric anchors (not stripped of line numbers) because a validation test deliberately enforces the numeric seam citation.
